title: PAR-134 R2010+ zero-fit HATCH and MPOLYGON spline tangents
mode: ODA-spec-backed parser correction with generated fast controls
scope: Read R2010+ HATCH and MPOLYGON spline-boundary tangent vectors after the fit-point array when fit count is zero
Retain bounded reads and finite-value validation for both tangent vectors
Keep R2004/R2007 boundary spline layouts unchanged

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf
odaDwgSpecification.finding: After the BL fit-point count and repeated 2RD fit points, the specification lists 2RD start and end tangent vectors without making them conditional on a nonzero fit-point count.

evidence.reproduction: The generated AC1024 MPOLYGON gradient case had a spline boundary with zero fit points, followed by a second edge and a LINE entity sentinel. The writer emitted the tangents as specified; the shared parser skipped them and consequently read tangent bytes as the next edge type.
evidence.decision: Follow ODA v5.4.1: consume both tangent vectors for every R2010+ HATCH-family spline boundary, including fit-count zero. No writer change was needed.

changes.reader: src/drw_entities.cpp now reads both bounded 2RD tangent vectors after the R2010+ fit-point array, regardless of fit count, and rejects truncated or non-finite vectors.
changes.generatedTests: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp now encodes the zero-fit tangent fields in its independent HATCH boundary wire control. Existing generated HATCH/MPOLYGON spline writer-reader controls verify zero-fit and populated-fit cases, boundary continuation, and following-entity alignment. The CMC gradient selector also exercises an AC1024 MPOLYGON zero-fit boundary with a following LINE.

commands.result: PASS (generated AC1024 MPOLYGON zero-fit boundary and following LINE)
PASS (HATCH/MPOLYGON R2010+ spline wire and file roundtrips)

limits: The vectors are generated locally and agree with the ODA layout; no independent producer sample qualified the zero-fit tangent form in this slice.
The broader dwg_read sample lane has seven unresolved failures outside reported entity parsing; no baseline comparison was performed.
This does not qualify HATCH/MPOLYGON support or promote any external/platform support claim.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added; the worktree is broadly dirty and this slice is uncommitted.
next: Self-unblock to another locally evidenced plan item. Resume associative-action dwgResbufValueKind changes only with its exact ODA consumer field layout. Keep remaining CMC methods and external/platform semantic qualification separate.
